links.outcome: LLM diagnostic accuracy on real-world polysomnography reports versus expert consensus, by case complexity
links.effect: Fully correct diagnostic rates ranged from 75.0% to 86.3%; all models degraded on complex cases (11.8-25.7 percentage point decline); safety rates exceeded 88%.
links.quote: All models demonstrated significant performance degradation on complex cases (11.8-25.7 percentage point decline).

screen.reason: Retrospective benchmark of nine commercial LLMs interpreting real-world polysomnography reports, evaluating diagnostic accuracy, recommendation quality, and safety without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
